questions.stem: Evaluate the function f(x) = 3x - 1 at x = 4.

questions.stem: Evaluate the function g(x) = x^2 - 4x + 5 at x = 0.
questions.solution: Substitute x = 0 into the function: g(0) = (0)^2 - 4(0) + 5 = 5.
